patches.name: Block Speak-to-Chat gesture
patches.description: Turns Speak-to-Chat back off whenever the headset switches it on by itself, such as the two-finger hold on the WH-1000XM4 touch panel. The other touch controls and the in-app Speak-to-Chat switch keep working.

repoDescription: ReVanced patches for Sony | Sound Connect: block the Speak-to-Chat touch gesture
